scope: Every JSON number token in the complete RecallEnvelopeV2 document, before conversion to a generic JSON value or JSON Schema validation.
schema_limitation: JSON Schema draft 2020-12 integer assertions use mathematical value semantics and can accept 10.0 or 1e1. They do not enforce this lexical token rule.

rejection_layers.rejected_tokens: Well-formed JSON numbers whose spelling is not an integer token: a decimal point or an exponent marker. These parse as JSON, and a JSON Schema `type: integer` assertion may accept them, so the lexical preflight is the only thing that rejects them.
rejection_layers.rejected_malformed_tokens: Spellings that are not well-formed JSON numbers at all: a leading `+`, or a leading zero followed by another digit. RFC 8259 forbids both, so a conforming parser rejects the whole document before any schema or type-driven check can run. They are listed separately because a consumer cannot reach them through a generic JSON value the way it can reach the tokens above.
